JUDGMENT:
                      O R D E R
     Leave granted.
     Heard the  counsel on  both sides.  The High Court per-
judged the issue by directing to pay as if the respondent is
a  regular   employee.   Since   this   issue   is   pending
adjudication, the High Court is not justified in giving such
direction.
     Accordingly, the  direction is  set  aside.  Since  the
matter is  pending in  the High  Court,  we  request  it  to
dispose of  the same as expeditiously as possible preferably
within six months, giving preference to the writ petition.
     The appeal is accordingly allowed.
